notes.title: Improvements and fixes - Patch 2.02 is here!
notes.content:
Dear Terra Alians,

We are pleased to announce the release of Patch 2.02, addressing all reported issues, both major and minor. We trust that these enhancements will contribute to an improved and seamless gaming experience. Thank you for your continued support!

Patch notes: 

 Fixed issue with Dialogue challenges in the ATM deducting Lingua points.
 Improved readability of Asian characters.
 Fixed an issue that won't display Icons correctly in the ATM Dictionary.
 Fixes on sound FX cuts.
 Fixes in characters and phrases.
 The avatar doesn't make short random movements when entering elevators.
 Tech syndicate level properly hides objects that shouldn't be visible.
 The first quest of Magnus fixed the sequence to unlock the transistor.
 Fixes in some buildings in the desert to avoid camera clipping.
 You can no longer access areas in the desert that do not contribute to the gameplay.
 The sphynx is deactivated at the end of the challenge, and the challenge icon is not displayed.
 Navigation and graphical Improvements in the desert.
 Fixed issue related to the cutscene in the Downtown area that opened Balthazar's shop was resolved.
 Fixed an issue related to the Holy Ground quest where the Portal wouldn't activate was resolved.
 Fixed an issue related to the duplication of the 30 Parallel Games splash-screen.
 Fixed an issue related to the overlapping of Romanisation and Voice Over icons in the Dialogue Challenges' UI in Downtown was corrected.
 The Korean word for Vase was corrected.
 The German word for Vase was corrected.
 The French word for Container was corrected.
 The French word for Can was corrected.

notes.title: Post-Update: HotFix 01
notes.content:
Dear players,

Thanks to your bug reports, we were able to identify and fix several issues found in the updated Terra Alia game. We appreciate your support and cooperation in helping us improve the game. Please continue to share your feedback with us so that we can make Terra Alia even better for all of our players. Thank you!

Fixed issues:

  Occasionally, when practicing Dialogue Challenges on the ATM, the NPC's may not possess the accurate method for regaining Lingua. As a result, completing the exercise may decrease the Lingua instead of increasing it.  At times, the comparison of equipment stats may be displayed in green color even when the new stat is lower than the previous one.  After a battle, the fog of war on the map may get reset unexpectedly.  Sometimes, when exiting the game, the medals earned might not get saved accurately.

notes.title: Terra Alia: Update 2.0!
notes.content:
🎉 The latest Terra Alia update is now available! 🎉
Experience new features and bug fixes, including:

INTERFACE:

More graphic options have been added, such as changing screen resolution, screen mode, and antialiasing.
Support for ultra-wide screens has been added.

GAMEPLAY:

Players can now zoom in and out with the scroll wheel of their mouse.
ATM automatic translations can now be turned off.
Several bugs and blockers that occasionally occur on side quests have been fixed.
Numerous other improvements and fixes have been implemented based on player feedback.

DIALOGUE CHALLENGES:

Dialogue Challenges have been updated to include three easier exercises before taking the more challenging test.
Tests now consist of translating a question and then answering it.
Rewards are now given based on the number of exercises completed on a given character.
The hint system now unlocks all possible hints on a given exercise instead of just one word.
Completing all tests is no longer necessary to progress. Obtaining one reward allows the player to advance.
Each reward level now grants the player a Bronze, Silver, or Gold medal, depending on the character.
The inventory screen and map now track how many Gold Medals the player has obtained.
Characters that disappear after their Dialogue Challenge will leave behind a Hologram version of themselves, allowing the player to obtain the Gold Medal.
Linguistic tips have been added to Dialogue Challenges, explaining some basic theories of the grammar of each language.
The option to play without Dialogue Challenges has been removed.

COMBAT:

A visual indicator has been added to show the zones where random encounters can occur in the University Campus, City Downtown, and the Desert Dungeon.
A new Tech Spell has been added, providing more crowd control options.
Combat has been rebalanced, adjusting the resistances, power, spell pool and cost of some enemies.
A new timeline indicator has been introduced in combat to improve the readability of the current state of the encounter, with three different options to visualize it.


Update 2.0 has introduced many new features into the game and fixed a lot of outstanding game issues. However in order to take advantage of the update all players will have to start a new game. This was unfortunately something we could not mitigate and apologize to all of you who are affected by this. 
We hope that all the improvements introduced in this update will make up for this inconvenience!

notes.title: Patch Version 1.1.4
notes.content:
Hey everyone, thank you for your continued feedback on the game. If you haven't already, be sure to join the Discord and the conversation to continue improving the game! 

This week's patch focusing on fixing several bugs players have been running into lately as well as adding a new options into the game:

- Added a new option on the options menu to activate or deactivate the romanization or romanjis. 
- Fixed an issue that prevented the player from completing Cloe and Hiro Quests 
- Fixed an issue that caused some Japanese phrases and voiceovers to appear when playing with Italian as the source or target language 
- Fixed an issue that sometimes caused the ATM not to work as intended

We are also excited about our trading cards and other community items going live today, so be sure to start collecting.

Thank you again for your support and your feedback to help improve our game.

notes.title: Update 1.2 - New Game Modes
notes.content:
Thank you for your continued support of our game. The feedback you provide is helping the team improve Terra Alia and maximize it's potential.

We are introducing a new way to play the game which we are calling Vocabulary Mode. This will allow the player to have a more traditional gaming experience since the dialogue challenges are no longer required. We still left vocabulary in the game because our vision for the game is to still introduce players to a language they would like to learn while still playing a game.

Players can also opt for playing the game the way it was meant to be played in Dialogue Challenge mode. We want to encourage players to use this mode to get the full experience. 

Terra Alia is fundamentally a language learning game. We want players from all over the world to enjoy the game, and to experience a new language. There are over 100 language pairings available and around 400 vocabulary words to discover in each language. We are actively updating and reacting to your feedback and look forward to your continued support.

notes.title: Post-Launch Update: 1.1
notes.content:
Hey everyone! 


Thank you again for your continual feedback on Terra Alia. The developers are hard at work implementing your feedback from playing the game. We also wanted to celebrate our first month after launching from early access with a 50% discount! 

There are some notable changes and updates that we made this month. Most notably, we have implemented a save system so the player can have up to five slots. This allows you to try more languages without losing any progress! Thanks again for the feedback to make this change possible!

Art

- Fixed some windows outside of the academy that have a chance of not applying its material correctly.


Gameplay

- Added five save slots.
- Removed common lockbox as a reward of combat.
- Adjusted casting time of some spells.
- Reduced mana and lingua cost of all offensive spells.
- Now you can equip and unequip your gear by double-clicking it.

UI & Visuals

- Adjusted position of foes and camera rotation on some combat scenes.
- Increased the gain and frequency of the camera shake when hit or being hit in combat.
- Fixed some Lingua spells to be area spells on max level.
- Fixed a few translation issues on certain inventory pop-ups.
- Fixed certain spells showing incorrect info on their tool-tips.
- Improved the tool-tip on spell relating to the casting speed.

Music & SFX

- Fixed wrong VO for "vase."
- Removed some SFX overlapping each other during a cinematic scene in the desert and a combat scene.
- Fixed a bug that prevented dungeon music from being correctly played sometimes.
- Added sounds effects to certain computers that were missing it.

Bugs and Fixes

- Updated terrain outside the academy to fix two places where the player could appear sinking on the ground.
- Assigned correct spells to some enemies that were using the player version of the same spell.
- Fixed an issue with the female portrait on character creation.
- Fixed an issue where the Health/Mana/Lingua was not being updated correctly.
- Fixed certain issues when selecting skin tone/hair color when creating the character.
- Fixed palette not having the correct translation
- Fixed an error message when interacting with the downtown statue under certain conditions.
- Fixed an issue where you could interact with the shop book the second time you enter the shop, after the combat with the Jackal Man.
- Fixed quest marker on statue not disappearing after interacting with it during the Falco Sidequest.
- Fixed Arkel not having a quest marker.
- Fixed the final platform on desert not having a quest marker.
- Fixed feather and ink object not having the correct translation.

Performance

- More light performances applied outside of the academy.
- Several NPC in the downtown level has been optimized to increase performance.
- Added a setting option to disable the campus grass completely.

Again, thank you so much for you feedback on this game. We wanted to try something new and different.

notes.title: Terra Alia monthly update and Patch Notes 0.4.0
notes.content:
Patch Notes Terra Alia
Version 0.4.0
Date 12/05/2020

This month we have an exciting update to share! Voiceovers have arrived! Now whenever you select an object, you will hear native pronunciations to practice and repeat. We also are adding voiceover dialogues for main characters in the story that are spoken in each of the ten offered languages. Make sure to keep practicing your language!

Gameplay

 Voiceover is now available in every language!
 Discovering a word will now play its pronunciation in target language.
 Dialogue challenges have now voiceover on the question as a whole and on every part of the sentence and the same for the question you have to build.
 ATM has full support of voiceover on every training available.
 Esperanto text has now voiceover.
 Lockboxes now can be found scattered around the world.
 Lockboxes now can contain coins.
 New batch of spells for combat added.
 Counter attack talent now works properly
 When a Dialogue Challenge is completed now it is added to the ATM even if you haven’t scanned the NPC before.


UI

 Improved Tooltip for Items on inventory
 Improved Spell description tooltip in combat
 Improved shield visualization in combat for player and enemies
 New Art for the cutscenes
 Updated text fonts to properly show all the symbols and characters
 Several size and fit issues fixed
 Improved colors for the character creator.
 Fixed several text that was missing a reference or pointing to the wrong language
 Romanization of special character languages added to the Focus mini game.


Performance

 Improved lighting on the campus outside scene meaning less resource consumption
 Improved UI methods to not be constantly waiting for interaction.
 Battle scene on the campus outside revamped and lighting issues fixed avoiding low fps.
